column1: Put the tomatoes and unpeeled garlic in a baking dish, season with salt, pepper and oregano, pour over the olive oil and toss to coat.
Set the feta in the middle with the tomatoes around it. Sprinkle the feta with a little more oregano and drizzle with oil.
Bake 25–30 minutes until the tomatoes blister and the feta softens.
With 10 minutes left, cook the pasta in well-salted water. Save some pasta water before draining.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins into the dish and mash with a fork.
Stir everything together, breaking up the feta into a creamy sauce.
Add the pasta and basil and mix, loosening with a splash of pasta water if needed.
